Name: Flatten
Description: Flattens terrain toward a histogram-selected, normalized, absolute, or local-neighborhood level.

Sections.Name: Level
Sections.Label: Flatten level
Sections.Description: Choose the level that the terrain is flattened toward.

Params.Name: TargetMode
Params.Label: Target mode
Params.Description: Selects whether Target is a histogram percentile, normalized level, absolute height, or a local neighborhood average.

Params.Name: Target
Params.Label: Target
Params.Description: Flattening level. In Histogram percentile mode, 0.5 is the median from the GPU histogram; in Normalized range mode it is a 0-1 position.

Params.Name: Radius
Params.Label: Local radius
Params.Description: Neighborhood radius used by Local neighborhood mode and Local blend.

Params.Name: LocalBlend
Params.Label: Local blend
Params.Description: Blends the selected target with the surrounding neighborhood average.
